name: ELRIDGE
recent: Elridge Energy 近期宣布以 RM45mil 收购六条活性炭生产线，进军下游活性炭业务，并计划将产能提升 50%。同时，公司执行董事兼首席执行官 Yeo Hock Cheong 在 10 月份多次增持公司股份。最新季度财报显示营收与净利均同比增长。
notable: 公司以 RM45mil 收购六条活性炭生产线，进军活性炭业务。
公司计划将产能提升 50%，以满足日本生物质需求。
执行董事兼首席执行官 Yeo Hock Cheong 在 10 月份多次增持公司股份。
risks: 执行董事兼首席执行官在 10 月份多次申报股份交易，需留意后续持股变动。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日季度，营收为 MYR131.7mil，同比增长 26.5%，环比增长 0.7%；净利为 MYR22.2mil，同比增长 78.5%，环比增长 24.8%；净利率为 16.8%，高于上一季度的 13.6%。

recent_en: Elridge Energy recently announced a RM45 million acquisition of six activated carbon production chains to enter the downstream activated carbon business, and plans to lift capacity by 50%. Meanwhile, Executive Director and CEO Yeo Hock Cheong acquired shares multiple times in October. The latest quarterly results showed year-on-year growth in both revenue and net profit.
notable_en: The company is acquiring six activated carbon production chains for RM45 million to enter the activated carbon business.
The company plans to lift capacity by 50% to meet Japanese biomass demand.
Executive Director and CEO Yeo Hock Cheong acquired shares multiple times in October.
risks_en: The Executive Director and CEO reported multiple share dealings in October; further changes in shareholding should be monitored.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR131.7 million, up 26.5% year-on-year and 0.7% quarter-on-quarter; net profit was MYR22.2 million, up 78.5% year-on-year and 24.8% quarter-on-quarter; net margin was 16.8%, higher than 13.6% in the previous quarter.
